description: List what changed in the directory lately: products whose agent level moved between two drives, with the date, the cause and the level now, newest first. Send a slug to get every dated change at one product you picked (level, surfaces that appeared or stopped answering, price and plan, each with its source); use get_provider for its full drive result. Read-only, no key needed; narrow it with days, category or slug.

category.description: Only this category: an id or name from list_categories

days.description: How many days back to look, 1 to 31 (default 7)

slug.description: Only this product: its slug from search_tools. Adds changes, its every public change since its first drive

name: list_changes
title: What changed lately
